description: This file defines functions related to context pruning tools, including normalizing glob patterns and creating predicates to determine if a tool is prunable based on allow and deny glob patterns. It imports external pattern matching utilities and type definitions, and exports a function for use in other parts of the project.

methods.name: function normalizeGlob(value: string) { normalizeGlob
methods.description: Normalizes a glob pattern string by trimming, converting to lowercase, and handling null or undefined values.

methods.name: export function makeToolPrunablePredicate( makeToolPrunablePredicate
methods.description: Creates a predicate function to determine if a tool name should be pruned based on allow and deny glob patterns.

ctags.name: allow
ctags.pattern: /^  const allow = compileGlobPatterns({ raw: match.allow, normalize: normalizeGlob });$/

ctags.name: deny
ctags.pattern: /^  const deny = compileGlobPatterns({ raw: match.deny, normalize: normalizeGlob });$/
